name: Koutei ni Iru Onna no Ko
source:
There's a ghost girl in the depths of the school. The girl asks "Am I above? Or are you below? Answer my question and face the consequences".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
学校深处有一个幽灵女孩。女孩问“我在上面吗？还是你在下面？回答我的问题并承担后果”。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
